name: Background
description: A full-frame background: one colour, or a gradient from color (through via) to `to`, linear at angle or radial from the centre, with optional film grain (noise 0-1). Colours are theme tokens (bg, fg, accent) or CSS colours. Put it on the main track (a title card) or a free video track under the text.
author: Biliup

color.description: The colour (or the gradient's first colour): a theme token or a CSS colour.

to.description: Makes it a gradient from color to this colour.

angle.description: A linear gradient's direction in degrees, CSS-style (180 = top to bottom, the default).

gradient.description: With `to`: linear (the default, along angle) or radial (from the centre out). D131.

noise.description: Film grain over the fill, 0 (none) to 1. D131.
